propositions: The mutation gate runs from refs/heads/main but executes against the checked-out patchset tree, causing hard-failure (exit code 2) when the change predates the commit that introduced scripts/mutation_gate.py.
When scripts/mutation_gate.py is absent from the checked-out tree, the gate exits with code 2 and reports Verified -1, failing the change despite no quality evaluation occurring.
Sibling gates (env-var registry gate, check_comment_hygiene) guard for missing scripts by skipping cleanly with an explanatory message and exit 0, but the mutation gate lacks this guard.
The mutation gate must skip with exit 0 and an explanatory message when scripts/mutation_gate.py is absent, matching sibling gate behavior.
Changes based on commits after the walking-skeleton commit (57d19254) must still execute the mutation gate normally; the skip guard must not silently bypass current changes.
